summary: Controladora Vuela (Volaris) filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, attaching a press release reporting preliminary July 2026 traffic results. The release details capacity (ASMs +14.4% YoY), demand (RPMs +18.5%), load factor (87.9%, +3.0 pp), and passengers (3.3 million). CEO Enrique Beltranena commented on disciplined capacity deployment and plans to trim growth in fall. This is a routine operational update, not a special-situation event. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. The filing contains only standard traffic metrics and management commentary, with no deal terms or structural changes.
